How to get it :
- Crafting table (x2) : [[gv:rod_dual_empty|Empty Dual Rod]].
- Crafting table (x4) : [[gv:rod_quad_empty|Empty Quad Rod]].
- Crafting table (x16) : 6 x Steel Plate, 2 x Lead Plate.

Used to make :
[[gv:rod_ac227|Actinium-227 Rod]], [[gv:rod_co|Cobalt Rod]], [[gv:rod_co60|Cobalt-60 Rod]], [[gv:rod_dual_empty|Empty Dual Rod]], [[gv:rod_lithium|Lithium Rod]], [[gv:rod_np237|Neptunium-237 Rod]], [[gv:rod_pu238|Plutonium-238 Rod]], [[gv:rod_pu239|Plutonium-239 Rod]], [[gv:rod_quad_empty|Empty Quad Rod]], [[gv:rod_ra226|Radium-226 Rod]] and 8 more.
